thread:
nina: FYI our unit tests started failing after upgrading to @redwood/inference@1.9.1. Error in vitest: "Cannot use import statement outside a module" referencing node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/index.js. Tests are ESM (package.json type: "module").

omar: Sounds like the package is ESM-only and vitest/esbuild didn't transform it. Try vitest config: deps.inline = ['@redwood/inference'] + optimizeDeps.include. That forces esbuild to handle it.

lee: Also confirm test environment: node vs jsdom. The SDK uses globalThis.fetch and Request; node environment without polyfills will blow up with "fetch is not defined" or "Request is not defined". We add an import to a fetch shim in setupFiles.

nina: I added deps.inline and a setup file that imports undici polyfill, which fixed the runtime Request error. But mocking still fails: vi.mock('node:http') yields "Cannot use import statement outside a module" in the mock resolution.

omar: Vitest mocks for node builtins sometimes need ESM stubs. Create tests/mocks/node-http.mjs that exports minimal API and use resolve.alias in vitest config: {'node:http': pathToStub}. That avoids transpiler confusion.

lee: For teams on jest, remember jest ignores node_modules transforms. Use transformIgnorePatterns to allow the SDK to be transformed, or run jest with --experimental-vm-modules + extensionsToTreatAsEsm. Both are fiddly.

ci-bot: infra-note: CI runs Node 20 and vitest 0.33. Some flakes observed when SDK bumped to 1.9.x.

nina: Plan: 1) add deps.inline + optimizeDeps, 2) add undici fetch shim in vitest setupFiles, 3) add small ESM stubs for node builtins we mock and alias them in config, 4) open a DX issue requesting a test-friendly SDK entry that avoids top-level edge-only calls. Will attach minimal repro. Thanks! :rocket:
